details: The cryptocurrency market is currently experiencing a broad risk-off phase, notably impacting altcoins like VeChain, which saw declines. This trend is primarily attributed to surging US Treasury yields and a strengthening US dollar. The underlying cause is hotter-than-expected economic data, which increases the likelihood of further interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. Such macroeconomic conditions typically lead investors to divest from riskier assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Surging US Yields Drive Crypto Market Risk-Off Sentiment

details: The Near Protocol (NEAR) token saw a significant surge of over 7% on Sunday, outperforming Bitcoin and the broader altcoin market. This bullish movement followed Bitwise's filing of the final prospectus for a spot NEAR exchange-traded fund (ETF). The proposed ETF aims to stake NEAR holdings, with most rewards being passed on to investors, which has generated considerable positive sentiment for the asset and highlights growing institutional interest in altcoins.
title: Bitwise Files Final Prospectus for Spot NEAR ETF, Token Surges

details: Oil prices have surged following claims by Yemen's Houthi rebels that they successfully attacked Saudi Aramco facilities. This escalation intensifies geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly concerning the security of crucial shipping routes such as the Strait of Hormuz. A rise in oil prices typically contributes to global inflation, which can influence central bank monetary policies and lead to a broader risk-off sentiment across financial markets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: Houthi Attacks on Saudi Facilities Spike Oil Prices
